references.text: Jesus speaks about not coming to bring peace, but a sword, and about the relationship between loving family more than him. This points to loyalty and the choice between following Jesus or not, similar to Matthew 12:30.
Jesus expresses a similar thought about being with him or against him in relation to carrying out God's work.
Jesus says that whoever is not against you is for you, which is an inverted formulation of the principle in Matthew 12:30.
Jeremiah speaks about those who are not on the Lord's side being scattered, which resembles the idea of gathering or scattering in Matthew 12:30.
The question of who stands up for God against the wicked, which can be seen as related to choosing a side, as in Matthew 12:30.
